goal: A structural archive has supplied two representations of one published peptide. Can we use them interchangeably when counting explicitly recorded cyclic topology? Compare the original records and their coordinate coverage. State what changing the representation changes about the scientific conclusion and whether these materials constitute independent observations. Give the measured counts and supporting evidence.

final_decision.rationale: Use the deposited _struct_conn record for the explicit topology count. In chain A, covale2 links the GLN 8 carbonyl C to the DAR 1 backbone N. The original closure count is {{metric:gxa_01m8fdh986x2mj3jat:declared_closure}} and the derivative count is {{metric:gxa_01m8fdh99j68cpt4bc:declared_closure}}. Removing that single row reproduces the derivative byte for byte, including its entire _atom_site table. The terminal atoms map in {{metric:gxa_01m8fdh986x2mj3jat:mapped_models}}/{{metric:gxa_01m8fdh986x2mj3jat:model_count}} original models and {{metric:gxa_01m8fdh99j68cpt4bc:mapped_models}}/{{metric:gxa_01m8fdh99j68cpt4bc:model_count}} derivative models. The first-model C–N distances are {{metric:gxa_01m8fdh986x2mj3jat:model_1_distance_A}} and {{metric:gxa_01m8fdh99j68cpt4bc:model_1_distance_A}}, respectively. First-model residue coverage is {{metric:gxa_01m8fdh9ccpmq5kprr:coordinate_coverage}} and {{metric:gxa_01m8fdh9hx98fkvf5q:coordinate_coverage}}, with {{metric:gxa_01m8fdh9ccpmq5kprr:ca_count}} and {{metric:gxa_01m8fdh9hx98fkvf5q:ca_count}} Cα sites and {{metric:gxa_01m8fdh9ccpmq5kprr:complete_backbones}} and {{metric:gxa_01m8fdh9hx98fkvf5q:complete_backbones}} complete backbones. Substituting the derivative would miss the explicitly recorded closure. The files describe one published solution NMR ensemble. The deletion supplies no evidence of ring opening.
